name: benchmark-vidore-v3-pharmaceuticals
description: benchmark-vidore-v3-pharmaceuticals is a multimodal benchmark assessing models on visual and textual understanding in the pharmaceuticals domain, including tasks such as visual question answering and interpretation of product or packaging imagery. It measures how well models combine visual input with domain knowledge to answer pharma-related queries accurately. The dataset targets domain-specific visual reasoning and retrieval.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific multimodal benchmark used by researchers working on medical/pharmaceutical vision-language tasks with limited mainstream adoption.
